strings.(마법학원 건물 안으로 두 사람이 천천히 들어간다.): (Two people walk slowly into the magic academy.)
strings.칼로네, 당신 왜 그렇게 말이 없어?: Callone, why are you so quiet?
I never expected a search for a lost cat to bring us all the way to the magic academy.
strings.마르텔리 영감님 부탁이라 어쩔 수 없었어. 길 잃은 고양이는 왠지 혼자: Old Martelli asked me. What could I do? I can never bring myself to leave a lost kitten all alone.
strings.제국이야 그렇다 치지만, 리베라에서도 용병단에게 금전적으로 도움을 주고: The Empire is one thing, but I understand Libera is also providing financial support to our mercenary company...
strings.그 돈은 대체 다 어디에 쓰이고 있는 겁니까?: Where exactly is all that money going?
strings.알고 싶어? 그 전에 내가 더 묻고 싶은 게 있어. 칼로네는 왜 이쪽으로: Want to know? First, there's something I'd like to ask. Why are you so reluctant to come here, Callone?
strings.돼, 됐습니다. 그만하죠. 어차피 제피로스와 클로리스 녀석들만 보지 않으: N-never mind. Forget I asked. As long as I don't run into Zephyros or Chloris... Ah, there's a Xerenis Magic Academy student.
strings.저기, 학생. 여기에 이런 고양이를 본 적 없습니까? 여기 전단지를 보시: Excuse me, student. Have you seen this cat around here? As you can see on the flyer, it has light brown fur and blue eyes... W-wait...
(Callone spots a female student and stops just as he is about to hand her a flyer.)
There aren't any cats here. Are you sure you have the right place? Oh, you're...
strings.자, 잘못 보셨습니다. 저희는 길 잃은 용병단을 찾는 고양이, 아, 아니: Y-you're mistaken. We're cats looking for a lost mercenary company. No, no. Just a passing cat, no... Whew...
strings.말이 헛나왔습니다. 무례를 용서하십쇼. 그런데, 고귀하신 분께서 여기엔: I misspoke. Please forgive my discourtesy. But what brings someone of your noble standing here?
strings.그건 제가 묻고 싶어요, 칼로네 님. 저는 여기 학생일 뿐인데, 여긴 무: That's what I'd like to ask you, Callone. I'm just a student here. What brings you to the academy? Magic Bureau business...?
strings.그렇다면 나중에 따로 오세요. 교장 선생님과 이사장 선생님은 지금 안 계: Then please come back another time. The headmaster and chairwoman are both away. Wait. The person with you...
strings.(시이나가 칼로네의 뒤에 가려 보이지 않던 파르밀라를 찾아낸다.): (Shiina notices Parmila, who had been hidden behind Callone.)
strings.마르텔리 영감님이 고양이를 찾으라는 게 이런 이야기였나…. 어쩔 수 없지: So this is what old Martelli meant by finding his cat... Oh, well.
strings.(파르밀라가 칼로네의 앞으로 나와 환하게 웃는다.): (Parmila steps in front of Callone with a bright smile.)
strings.오랜만이야, 아기 고양이. 시이나 던 실바리아 황녀님. 칼로네도 알고 있: Long time no see, little kitten. Princess Shiina Dawn Silvaria. You even know Callone? You're better connected than I thought.
strings.(…이거, 뭔가 귀찮은 일이 일어날 것 같은데….): (...I have a feeling this is about to get troublesome...)
